winCondition: Game ends when the main objective is completed, morale reaches 0, or the round track runs out. Players win only if the colony met the main objective and they also satisfied their own secret objective; a hidden Betrayer (if any) wins by their own separate condition. Exact end-check timing not verified against the rulebook.
